known_reference_discrepancies: Published equation 14 uses a pure Hebbian W update; the notebook uses a residual delta rule.
Notebook G prediction uses the next state while its target and outer product use the source state; published equation 17 consistently uses the current state.
Notebook DataLoader groups trajectories but its training loop selects only trajectory[0].
Notebook multiplicative zero masking does not reliably exclude actions with signed utilities.
Notebook checks arrival using the pre-action latent after appending an action and reward.
Notebook candidate reward selection does not require predicted arrival, and its outer execution loop exits after one selected action.
